tests.name: positive_quiet_strict
tests.note: 18 asserts; writes AGENT_HEALTH.json + .txt under absolute STATE; exit 0

tests.name: role_env_and_arg
tests.note: SYS ARG 0 OR then ENV OR resolves role without shell glue for values

tests.name: soft_p2p_peer_miss
tests.note: soft dial fails, FAIL/PASS/CLEAR_ERR recovery, health plate still written

tests.name: peer_without_soft_skip
tests.note: program refuses hard dial inside health script; recovers via policy FAIL/PASS/CLEAR_ERR

tests.name: state_parent_missing
tests.note: expected: write: No such file or directory; exit 1; err_line=0 err_src empty

tests.name: strict_sticky_footgun
tests.cmd: INCLUDE OR miss; PASS; no CLEAR_ERR; run -q -s
tests.note: expected: plate ok=false exit 1 despite PASS recovery — documents -s vs CLEAR_ERR

weaknesses.title: SYS WRITE fatal has err_line=0 and empty err_src
weaknesses.detail: When SYS WRITE fails (missing parent dir, EACCES, etc.) the run plate sets err/last_err to 'write: No such file or directory' but err_line stays 0 and err_src is "". Agents cannot jump to the failing statement; differs from ASSERT/FAIL/INCLUDE which fill line+src.

weaknesses.title: PASS recovery still fails run -s until CLEAR_ERR
weaknesses.detail: PASS restores OK/STATUS_OK but leaves sticky last_err. cubalc run -s flips plate ok=false and exit 1 even when the program intentionally recovered. Multi-probe health scripts must remember CLEAR_ERR after every soft path; easy agent footgun after INCLUDE OR / EXPECT / FAIL.
weaknesses.repro: INCLUDE OR missing_lib; PASS "ok"; STATUS; cubalc run -q -s → ok:false exit 1

weaknesses.title: No SYS MKDIR; CUBALC_STATE parent must pre-exist
weaknesses.detail: SYS STATE returns the configured path but does not create it. SYS WRITE does not mkdir -p parents. Real agents still need shell mkdir -p "$CUBALC_STATE" before any plate worker — partial shell glue the language claims to remove.
weaknesses.repro: export CUBALC_STATE=/tmp/new_$$ (no mkdir); SYS WRITE under STATE → write fatal

weaknesses.title: PRINT of string vars emits length only
weaknesses.detail: PRINT role with role="worker" prints 6 (LAST_N/len), not the characters. Agents debugging multi-probe scripts misread role/path/id as numbers unless they use PRINT_JSON/VARS. Surprising vs PRINT of numbers and board tokens.

weaknesses.title: Dynamic JSON plates require fragile quote-escape + multi CAT
weaknesses.detail: SYS WRITE accepts a JSON string only when source file preserves escapes; building {"role":$role,"digit":$dig} in-language needs chained SYS CAT and careful quoting. Health plate ends up with hardcoded role/digit fields or plain .txt sidecar — not a first-class agent plate builder.
weaknesses.repro: try SYS WRITE path with interpolated LET role in JSON body — no clean form; see static schema in agent_health_plate

weaknesses.title: INCLUDE SOFT runs lib body (side effects), not presence-only
weaknesses.detail: INCLUDE SOFT mesh_exchange executes SMX EXCHANGE and can place/touch peer0/peer1 before the caller is ready. Health scripts must use SYS WHICH / REQUIRE LIB for catalog presence; soft INCLUDE is not a dry resolve.
weaknesses.repro: INCLUDE SOFT mesh_exchange with no prior CUBE peer0 peer1 — still runs EXCHANGE (n cubes may change)

workarounds: After every INCLUDE OR / EXPECT fail / intentional FAIL: PASS then CLEAR_ERR before STATUS or exit when using run -s
Build plate paths with SYS STATE + SYS CAT state_dir "/name.json" (absolute STATE works)
Probe optional libs with SYS WHICH, not INCLUDE SOFT, when body has side effects
Prefer PRINT_JSON / VARS / STATUS over PRINT for string values
Write simple .txt plates when dynamic JSON is too painful
language_gaps: SYS MKDIR / ensure STATE dir exists
PRINT should show string content (or PRINT_STR) not only length
In-language JSON object builder / SYS WRITE_JSON for agent plates
Path join form (STATE + name) and optional dry INCLUDE resolve
In-program enable of CUBALC_P2P_SOFT for health dials without host export (from iter1; still true)
